title: PNP vows to continue manhunt for ex-BuCor chief Bantag

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) vowed to continue its pursuit of former Bureau of Corrections (BuCor) chief Gerald Bantag following an unsuccessful operation to arrest him in Ifugao. “We will not allow the passage of time or repeated attempts to evade arrest to weaken our resolve,” PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez
